thread_text:
jamie: quick heads-up: canary for SDK 4.0.0 showed a parser error for long sequences. proposing scoped runtime pin for tonight's change window (22:00 UTC) to avoid Dedicated customer impact.

jamie: log excerpt:
```
ERROR parser: unexpected token at seq_len>2048
model: llama3q-2.7.3-quant
runtime: 3.5.1
sdk: 4.0.0-canary
```

tanvi: ack. is it reproducible?

maria: repro only on longseq models (>2048). Core shortseq unaffected. ops-east advises pin.

jamie: plan: deploybot pin runtime:3.5.0-oldhash -> scope model-group:longseq-llama3q for 2h starting 22:00 UTC. monitor parser-error-rate and p95 latency. rollback thresholds: >1% error over 30m -> rollback.

alex: I'll add relnote stub and own postmortem if needed.

deploybot: scheduled pin pb-9812 at 2026-03-22T22:00:00Z per jamie.

deploybot: executed pb-9812 1 at 2026-03-22T22:00:07Z  pin active.

tanvi: monitoring: parser errors dropped after pin. holding 30m watch.

jamie: after 2h stable, lifting pin at 00:00 UTC. deploybot pin remove --id pb-9812 executed.

srebot: pb-9812 lifecycle recorded. no pager escalations.

alex: relnotes published: "Temporary runtime pin to mitigate SDK 4.0.0 long-sequence serialization regression; scoped to longseq models."

maria: Dedicated customer comms sent. closing thread.
